  • 2026 Canvas security incident In early May 2026, Instructure disclosed that it was investigating a cybersecurity incident involving certain user data, including names, email addresses, student ID numbers, and messages among users. on May 7, Canvas was hacked again; its login page was replaced with a ransomware message by ShinyHunters. It is unprecedent because it affected 8,809 universities, educational ministries, and other institutions worldwide.

  • from anti-government to anti-science: why conservatives have turned against science? 从反政府到反科学：自由市场的神话是保守派刻意制造出来的: 美国人对科学的不信任呈现出明显的党派倾向，这表明其根源可能更多地在于政治信仰和立场，而非科学家自身的所作所为或失职。在美国科学知识与监管制度之间联系的日益紧密，而后者正是保守派普遍反对的。简而言之，当代保守派对科学的不信任并非真正源于科学本身，而是附带损害，是民众对政府不信任的溢出效应。
